text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna make my move, it's now. 
—"Reraise"!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Given the situation, folding here would be 
totally fine, but— that wouldn't be any 
fun, would it!? —"All in"!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Hah! I knew you'd take the bait. 
...Though today, I'm not bluffing."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Here you go. Satisfied now, Your Majesty?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Ahh, this is the best. With 
this hair of mine, taking a bath usually 
just wears me out.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you're pleased. ...Next time, 
it's my turn to take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha! An uprising against the king, is it? 
Interesting... Let's see you try!

Having won the contest against Nakayama 
Festa, Sirius Symboli was able to rest 
comfortably.
